remarks:
Additional 164 sq. ft. difference from the tax records was confirmed by an appraisal done when the home was listed previously. Welcome to 5482 Broadway Street, located in Lancaster Village! Offering over 2,000 square feet of living space, this spacious home features 5 bedrooms, and 3 full bathrooms, providing plenty of room and flexibility to fit your needs. Blending original charm with modern updates, this home offers the perfect combination of character and convenience.

Upon entering, you are welcomed into a spacious living room that flows seamlessly into the dining room. The first floor also features an updated kitchen, a full bathroom, and an additional room that could easily serve as a 6th bedroom, home office, or den.

The second floor offers 3 generously sized bedrooms, an updated full bathroom, and the convenience of second-floor laundry. Continuing to the third floor, you will find 2 additional bedrooms and another full bathroom, providing even more living space and versatility.

This home also features a waterproofed basement and the roof was done in 2021, providing added peace of mind. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced yard, an expansive driveway with ample parking for multiple vehicles, and an attached shed at the rear of the home for additional storage. With its generous square footage, flexible floor plan, original character, and modern updates, this home offers endless possibilities in the desirable Village of Lancaster. Don't miss the opportunity to make this yours!
